vb_textbox.text: Every 8 or so rounds, the mushrooms awarded may switch on one of the colors. If brown was awarding the most, it may reward far less than the other choice presented, so it would benefit you to switch to the non-brown choice for several rounds. The same goes for purple. Once purple stops rewarding the most, use the opposing choice to purple. I don't believe brown and purple competed directly against each other, so just focus on what is currently the hot pick between 'brown' and 'not brown' OR purple and 'not purple'
